sunoData.title: Moonlit Glade
sunoData.tags: Ambient new-age with a slow-breathing, seamless loop feel; airy shimmer, distant twinkles, warm pad swells, and gently drifting tonal movement. The arrangement stays translucent throughout, opening with soft bell flecks and a low haze, then widening into layered glows and subtle reversed swells before settling back into a calm, enchanted loop. Ethereal ear candy includes tiny chime cascades, brushed air puffs, and slow stereo sparkles. Mix is soft-focus, spacious, and velvety., soft, warm
